objective: Prove the minimal lease then independent review then accept chain with fixed non-LLM handlers and zero budget.
constraints: Isolated canary lane only (score-canary-lane); no release lane access.
Fixed non-LLM handler execution only; no LLM dispatch and no paid provider calls.
Deterministic evidence written only under score-runs/{run_id}/.
Strict separation of duty: worker and reviewer roles differ; author cannot review own work.
No cloud:change, no repository:write, no secrets, tokens, or absolute host paths in resources.
budget_cents remains 0; max_cost_cents remains 0 on every task.

tasks.title: Lease and write deterministic canary artifact
tasks.instructions: Under a fenced lease, write a deterministic JSON artifact under score-runs/{run_id}/lease-review-accept.json and return its relative path and sha256. Do not call LLMs, mutate repositories, or touch host paths outside the run artifact root.

tasks.title: Independent hash verification and acceptance
tasks.instructions: Independently fetch the LRA-build artifact, verify exact bytes and sha256, confirm author and reviewer identities differ, and record an acceptance report. Reject on mismatch, traversal, or self-review.
